# Project memory: this app's core intent

This file is a stable reference for what this project is actually for.
**Do not edit this file unless the user explicitly asks you to change
it** — not as a side effect of implementing a feature, fixing a bug, or
any other task. README.md and docs/PROCESS.md evolve as the app changes;
this one only changes on direct instruction.

## Goal

Build an app that takes audio or video — or a fresh audio recording — and
transcribes it, then converts that description into an application the
user can actually use, matching whatever they described.

## Scope

Every functionality the user asked for must actually work in the
preview, so they know exactly what they're getting — not a partial or
representative subset, and not a UI that only looks like it works.

## Process

A small team of AI agents runs the whole SDLC for the user's application
— from understanding the description through to a working, previewable
result — and builds whatever the user actually asked for, in whatever
shape that requires. No particular app shape (e.g. "manages a list of
records") is assumed or forced onto a description that doesn't call for
it. The pipeline develops iteratively as the project goes — this is not
a one-time fixed design.
